problems.symptom: Writes report success while persisting nothing, or consumers read a key or table that isn't there (NULL vs NONE, SCHEMAFULL/Zod strips, missing view reads empty, bare vs prefixed ids, org_id forms)
problems.root_cause: No shared write-verification seam: surrealDB.query() ignores statement status, there is no NONE-coercion boundary, and there is no writer-to-reader key test; each instance was fixed at one call site

problems.symptom: Autonomous landings that are probes, echoes, duplicates, whitespace, or gamed predicates (gap id in code, invented field)
problems.root_cause: The land gate reads diffs and accepts typecheck-clean strings; one gap can be applied repeatedly; the pwt child loop rewards satisfying the checker

problems.symptom: Substrate landings delete or garble code, corrupt SQL inside strings, write the wrong dialect, reverse operator perf fixes, or gate production code on env to pass a test
problems.root_cause: Anchor/splice patching without a semantic diff check; SQL in strings is invisible to typecheck; failing-test gaps target production files

problems.symptom: Migrations silently skipped, failing forever, unparseable, or ledger says applied while the object is absent; retention cannot bound the store; index experiments go the wrong way

principles: A try/catch fallback cannot catch a missing SurrealDB table: it reads as empty, status OK (3322f92)
A slow failure inside a startup gate is worse than the fast failure it replaced; expensive DDL belongs out of band (8fbc032)
When a deliberate change measures worse twice, put it back and say so; the revert rests on the numbers, not on a counter-hypothesis (0da9c16, f4d62bf)
A constant calibrated for one population's cadence must not be copied to another (99ae266)
A Beta posterior over one observation is its prior; the key decides what can be learned (d553b39)
Both ends typecheck while a consumer three repos away reads a stripped key; only a cross-boundary test says so (48bc174)
New rows look correct, so write bugs on existing rows survive; fixing one copy leaves the others (11cd301)
A gate that reads a diff cannot certify; only a test that runs it can (e2730e1)
False abstention loses a blame signal; false blame condemns a working arm (970b112)
Let the measurement overrule the story that motivated the fix (3cafd9c)
Pre-validation with root credentials bypasses PERMISSIONS and cannot see what the service sees (23abbf4/89f04fb)
The migration ledger is intent, not state: applied rows can name objects that no longer exist (1f0d70f)
Fail closed on what you have not verified, including foreign-dialect statements (9c187af)
A detector's own query must be verified; one returning [] reads as 'clean' (db-admin safeCount, found in this pass)
One gap should equal one landing; repeated applies of a gap id produce duplicate code (route-edit-24e91280 x5 -> 781d758)
Commit messages must carry intent, because gap records get pruned (147 of 156 route-edit ids gone)
